sources.entry: GoCodeo - AI agent for building full-stack apps in minutes.

summary.name: GoCodeo
summary.one_liner: GoCodeo is an AI coding agent that generates, tests, and debugs code, integrating with VS Code and drawing on several third-party LLMs.
use_cases: asking coding questions inside the IDE
summary.what_it_does: GoCodeo is presented as an AI coding agent with Build, Ask, and Test modes for engineers. It integrates with VS Code and offers real-time AI-assisted coding, intelligent test generation, and auto-debugging. The page says it can use several LLMs, including Claude Sonnet 3.7 and 3.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4o, and OpenAI o3-mini. It claims support for major languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, TypeScript, C, C#, Rust, and Ruby, plus frameworks like React, Flask, Django, Next.js, and Node.js. The page also describes automating architecture-to-deployment work, but gives no detail on how this is done.
notable: Build, Ask, and Test modes for coding tasks
Lets users choose among multiple third-party LLMs such as Claude, Gemini, GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1
Focus on automated unit test generation
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Only VS Code integration is named on the page
Most of the page is marketing and testimonials; capabilities are not independently detailed
